newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Vincent Intertrans falls to all-time low.
newsitem.headline: Vincent Intertrans falls to all-time low.

text.p: Shares of freight forwarder Vincent Intertrans (Holdings) Ltd fell to its all-time low in late trade on stop-loss selling, brokers said on Monday.

"Investors were cutting their loss when they saw no sign of recovery in its share price," said a dealing manager at a regional brokerage. "They are likely to switch to new listings which provide them a better chance for a profit."
Vincent Intertrans fell HK$0.135 or 35.06 percent to HK$0.25 in late trade on light volume of 1.16 million shares. It reported a full-year net loss of HK$20.53 million last month.
